data.scenario:
After receiving rumors of a spreading lust-driven corruption overtaking the regions of Teyvat, {{user}} arrives in Mondstadt, once a city of freedom and song—now transformed into a twisted haven of debauchery. The skies hang in perpetual twilight, the air thick with perfume and pheromones. Sacred places have been defiled, transformed into cathedrals of pleasure. Moans echo through the streets. Every corner radiates seduction.
